purpose: Hardware comparison with per-image Android presentation semaphores; the preceding SteamVR driver and producer lease are unchanged

Android build-tools 35 aligned and signed with repository test key.
pre_install_validation: Linux CI: 22 launcher/producer/Android semaphore tests passed; native presenter, fence tracker, compositor submit, and semaphore layer regressions passed.
Full Android compositor and frame-generation engines compiled and linked.
Signer and APK alignment verified. Only the compositor library payload changed; Java/Dex, Linux driver, helper, and shared C++ runtime are unchanged.
limitations: Not a full Gradle APK build; donor label inherited.
Native build targets API 29 instead of donor API 26; both use NDK r27d and target the Android 13 Retroid.
Hardware impact pending before deployment. The SteamVR sync-texture warning is not directly addressed by this change.
